# Tuning Requirements Quality Checklist: Particle Universe — Phase 05 Profiling and low-end device tuning

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the A04-P05 requirements: completeness, privacy, architecture ownership, iOS lifecycle,
testability, performance and release constraints.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated 2026-11-13 by the lead under the owner's standing delegation. One item failed first (CHK008); the
specification was corrected.

## Completeness and Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are all three phase gates mapped to requirements? [Traceability, Spec §Traceability]
- [x] CHK002 Are the step-down and step-up rules quantified (window sizes, thresholds, shares)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A04-510]
- [x] CHK003 Is the gap length for the resume proof quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A04-503, SC-A04-501]
- [x] CHK004 Is "detail" defined as drawing only, never simulation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A04-513]
- [x] CHK005 Is the profile's label and content defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A04-520, Clarifications]

## Architecture Ownership and Lifecycle

- [x] CHK006 Is the relation between the frame-time controller and the heat/Low Power ceiling unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-A04-511, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK007 Are pause and background frames excluded from the windows? [Lifecycle, Spec §FR-A04-512]
- [x] CHK008 Is the controller's state across new sessions and context recreation specified? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — failed first: unstated; corrected: not saved, starts at full detail within the ceiling.
- [x] CHK009 Is "no VisualCore change, no standalone change" stated? [Ownership, Spec §FR-A04-540]

## Testability, Performance, Release, Privacy

- [x] CHK010 Is determinism of the controller required for injected sequences? [Testability, Spec §FR-A04-514]
- [x] CHK011 Are simulator numbers explicitly kept out of device evidence? [Release, Spec §Input]
- [x] CHK012 Are device measurements identified as {device} work? [Release, Spec §Input, Traceability]
- [x] CHK013 Are test durations bounded? [Performance, Spec §SC-A04-506]
- [x] CHK014 Does the feature add no network or data collection? [Privacy, Spec §FR-A04-540]
- [x] CHK015 Are isolated slow frames prevented from changing detail? [Edge Case, Spec §US2 AC4, Edge Cases]
